subject.title: fix(update): dev channel update builds from an unverified checkout at the git install path

question: Should package-to-dev conversion permanently refuse every pre-existing `OPENCLAW_GIT_DIR` except an interrupted checkout with matching updater-owned database and in-checkout markers?
rationale: This is an intentional security-versus-upgrade-compatibility contract: source code and tests cannot determine whether requiring operator relocation of existing destinations is the product policy maintainers want to ship.

options.title: Accept fail-closed conversion
options.body: Approve refusing all pre-existing destinations and retain the documented move-or-select-a-new-path recovery action.

options.title: Preserve an existing conversion path
options.body: Specify a narrowly trusted migration or explicit opt-in path for existing destinations, with corresponding security and upgrade proof.

recommendation.title: Accept fail-closed conversion
recommendation.body: Approve refusing all pre-existing destinations and retain the documented move-or-select-a-new-path recovery action.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR discussion already requests this exact updater-policy decision from vincentkoc.
